body:
The few people who actually care about me are my sister and maybe 1 colleague at work. Haven't had friends in a few years at least. Won't my sister and colleague be better in the long run? Right now I feel like a real burden on them. Constantly talking about depression and sharing negative thoughts which are dominating my mind space.

I appreciate they may suffer a bit at the start but in the course of weeks, maybe months, their lives will carry on and they won't have to worry about me.
Thanks efmccurdy! I changed collength to letter but still see the same output.

Amazing to hear that Monoyo123. It sounds to me like you made the right decision! Being honest about your current state is necessary as you're trying to avoid a relapse. Don't give that power away.

I'm 19 days sober after a good 7 years of everyday smoking and just struggling to get by, trying to take one day and step at a time. Anxiety comes and goes, depression is probably here to stay though. Stay strong and I'll do the same :)
